figures.caption: Dedicated adaptive-attempt ASR by round with raw success/denominator labels and Wilson 95% confidence bands. The zero-anchored, data-driven focused 0–10% y-scale improves legibility without amplifying the evidence; exact k/n labels are authoritative.
figures.title: E16 attack success rate by adaptive round
warnings: Dedicated E16 denominator; do not combine with the frozen six-condition main matrix.
Parse failures, timeouts, and unresolved outcomes remain in the round denominator.
The focused 0–10% y-axis is anchored at 0% and expands from the observed ASR and Wilson bounds; do not read the visual scale as a larger effect.
Rounds are discrete designed attempts; connecting segments do not imply a continuous time trend.
